title: The Impact of Endoscopic Endonasal Skull Base Surgery on Olfaction
official: The Impact of Endoscopic Endonasal Skull Base Surgery on Olfaction
summary: In this study, the research team will investigate the incidence and etiology of olfactory dysfunction following endoscopic endonasal skull base surgery, by combining clinical assessments with histomolecular analysis.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients scheduled for endoscopic endonasal skull base surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pre-existing anosmia
* Patients has a history of previous endoscopic endonasal skull base surgery

sites.f: Max Planck Research Unit for Neurogenetics
